title: AgentGPT
description: Browser-based platform to configure and deploy autonomous AI agents that pursue goals you specify, with optional self-hosting.

title: AutoGen
description: Microsoft's open-source framework for building event-driven, multi-agent conversation systems with human-in-the-loop.

title: AutoGPT
description: Open-source project for building autonomous AI agents that plan and execute goals by chaining LLM calls with tools.

title: BabyAGI
description: Minimal open-source script demonstrating an autonomous, task-driven agent that creates and prioritizes its own tasks.

title: CrewAI
description: Open-source framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents that collaborate as a crew.

title: Dify
description: Open-source LLM app platform with a visual builder for agents, RAG pipelines, and workflows.

title: Flowise
description: Open-source, drag-and-drop UI for building LLM apps and agents as visual flows, built on LangChain.

title: LangChain
description: Widely-used open-source framework for building LLM-powered applications with composable chains, memory, and agents.

title: LangGraph
description: Library for building stateful, multi-agent workflows as graphs with fine-grained control over loops and branching.

title: LlamaIndex
description: Open-source data framework for building LLM-powered applications over private or domain-specific data, with strong agent support.

title: n8n
description: Open-source, node-based workflow automation connecting hundreds of apps with code-level flexibility and self-hosting.

title: Zapier
description: No-code automation platform connecting thousands of apps through trigger-based 'Zaps', including built-in AI steps.
